messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@lumatech.com>, Tom Baker <tom.baker@lumatech.com>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal / expansion mutual plan: onboarding, usage review, and next steps

Hi Elena / Tom —

Congrats again on selecting Redwood for the expanded license. To keep momentum and make the renewal seamless, I’ve put together a short mutual action plan (MAP) draft that aligns on roles, milestones, success criteria, and a close timeline. I’ve attached the document and a usage snapshot from October to ground the conversation.

High-level goals we outlined with your team:
- Stabilize latency under 200ms p50 for customer-facing features
- Increase embedding throughput for search use case to 20k vectors/day
- Pilot the Dedicated capacity pool for peak hours (Nov–Jan)

Proposed owner list (please confirm or add):
- Customer exec sponsor: Elena Rossi (Lumatech)
- Procurement: Tom Baker (Lumatech Procurement)
- Redwood renewal lead: Vanessa Ortiz (me)
- Technical lead: Marcus Lin (redwood) — will own performance validation
- CS/Enablement: Laura Bennett (redwood) — onboarding and adoption playbooks

Draft timeline (target close: 2026-12-17):
1) Week of Nov 8 — MAP sign-off & procurement kickoff
2) Nov 15–30 — Performance validation and Dedicated pool sizing
3) Dec 1–10 — Contract redlines and SOC evidence exchange
4) Dec 11–17 — Final approvals, invoice issuance, and cutover plan

Asks for this week:
1) Please confirm the two Lumatech stakeholders above and add any others who need to be in the procurement thread.
2) Any hard constraints on the close date or procurement windows we should know about?
3) Marcus and Laura — can you both review the attached MAP and usage CSV and call out any gaps for the validation plan?

I’ll set a 30-minute kickoff next week (suggested slots in the calendar invite I’ll send after I hear back).

Thanks — looking forward to aligning and making this low-friction.

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Exec, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference
+1 (415) 555-0134

Attachments: Lumatech_MAP_v1.pdf (MAP draft), usage_report_Oct2026.csv (token & embedding counts)

Subject: Re: Renewal / expansion mutual plan: onboarding, usage review, and next steps

Vanessa — thanks for the clear plan and the attachments. Lumatech is ready to proceed; a couple of notes from our side: 

1) Stakeholders: Please add our infra lead, Paolo Conti (paolo.conti@lumatech.com), to the technical validation loop. He’ll own Dedicated capacity sign-off.
2) Procurement window: We have a procurement freeze the week of Nov 22 (internal budget reviews), so if we want to hit the Dec 17 close, we should aim to have most commercial terms agreed before Nov 19.
3) Success criteria: Would you be able to add an objective metric for embedding recall improvement (baseline vs target) in the MAP? That will help our product QA team sign off.

I’m available for a kickoff call Nov 9 or Nov 10 afternoon CET. Tom will loop in procurement-specific paperwork after the kickoff.

Best,
Elena
Head of Product
Lumatech

Thanks Vanessa — I reviewed the usage CSV quickly. A few technical comments for the MAP validation section: 

- Embedding recall: we can add an A/B test metric (current baseline from your data = 0.62 NDCG@10; target = +0.07 absolute improvement) — will put the exact numbers in the MAP.
- Latency SLOs: to reliably hit p50 <200ms we should size Dedicated pool for peak concurrency of ~18 concurrent requests based on Oct peaks; I’ll include a sizing table.
- Test plan: propose a 48-hour validation window in staging that mirrors traffic for the top 3 customer flows; Paolo should be able to provide staging access details.

Action items for me: I’ll update the MAP draft with metrics and an initial Dedicated sizing recommendation and circulate by EOD Nov 7. Laura, can you add adoption milestones tied to feature rollout dates?

—Marcus
Staff ML Engineer, Redwood Inference
